sentences.text: Desde que cumplió diez años, Marta soñaba con tener una bicicleta.
sentences.english: Ever since she turned ten, Marta had dreamed of having a bicycle.

sentences.text: Todos los días veía pasar a los niños del barrio en sus bicicletas.
sentences.english: Every day she saw the children of the neighborhood go by on their bicycles.

sentences.text: Una noche se lo dijo a su padre.
sentences.english: One night she told her father.

sentences.text: —Papá, quiero una bicicleta, ¿me la puedes comprar? —dijo.
sentences.english: "Dad, I want a bicycle, can you buy it for me?" she said.

sentences.text: Pedro pensó un momento.
sentences.english: Pedro thought for a moment.

sentences.text: —Una bicicleta cuesta mucho —dijo—, y no podemos comprarla ahora, pero te propongo algo.
sentences.english: "A bicycle costs a lot," he said, "and we can't buy it now, but I have a proposal."

sentences.text: —Cuando hayas ahorrado la mitad del dinero, yo pondré la otra mitad.
sentences.english: "When you have saved half of the money, I will put in the other half."

sentences.text: Marta aceptó enseguida.
sentences.english: Marta accepted right away.

sentences.text: Al día siguiente fue a ver a don Carlos, un vecino que tenía un jardín grande.
sentences.english: The next day she went to see don Carlos, a neighbor who had a big garden.

sentences.text: —Don Carlos, ¿necesita que alguien lo ayude con el jardín? —preguntó.
sentences.english: "Don Carlos, do you need someone to help you with the garden?" she asked.

sentences.text: —Pues sí —dijo don Carlos—, porque mis rodillas ya no son como antes, y si vienes los sábados, te pagaré por tu trabajo.
sentences.english: "Well, yes," said don Carlos, "because my knees are not what they used to be, and if you come on Saturdays, I will pay you for your work."

sentences.text: Desde entonces, cada sábado Marta regaba las plantas y sacaba las malas hierbas.
sentences.english: From then on, every Saturday Marta watered the plants and pulled the weeds.

sentences.text: Aunque a veces hacía calor y estaba cansada, no dejó de ir ni un solo sábado.
sentences.english: Although sometimes it was hot and she was tired, she did not miss a single Saturday.

sentences.text: Su madre guardaba el dinero en una lata para que no se perdiera.
sentences.english: Her mother kept the money in a tin so that it would not get lost.

sentences.text: Luis, que ya tenía una bicicleta vieja, le dijo que le enseñaría a montar en cuanto tuviera la suya.
sentences.english: Luis, who already had an old bicycle, told her he would teach her to ride as soon as she had her own.

sentences.text: Pasaron los meses.
sentences.english: The months went by.

sentences.text: Un sábado, la lata estaba casi llena.
sentences.english: One Saturday, the tin was almost full.

sentences.text: Pedro contó el dinero y dijo: —Marta, ya has ahorrado la mitad.
sentences.english: Pedro counted the money and said, "Marta, you have already saved half."

sentences.text: Fueron a la tienda y Marta eligió una bicicleta roja.
sentences.english: They went to the shop and Marta chose a red bicycle.

sentences.text: —Nunca había tenido algo tan bonito —dijo.
sentences.english: "I had never had anything so beautiful," she said.

sentences.text: Esa tarde Luis la llevó a la calle y le enseñó a montar.
sentences.english: That afternoon Luis took her to the street and taught her to ride.

sentences.text: Se cayó dos veces, pero no lloró.
sentences.english: She fell twice, but she did not cry.

sentences.text: A la tercera vez, pedaleó sola hasta el final de la calle.
sentences.english: The third time, she pedaled by herself to the end of the street.

sentences.text: —¡Lo logré! —gritó.
sentences.english: "I did it!" she shouted.

sentences.text: Don Carlos, que miraba desde su ventana, aplaudió.
sentences.english: Don Carlos, who was watching from his window, clapped.

sentences.text: Marta supo que el trabajo había valido la pena.
sentences.english: Marta knew that the work had been worth it.
